To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the key factors to generate value for the Spanish organic olive oil supply chain are the following: 1) The use of innovative technology and new products, 2) The development of new business models that allow to generate added value for all supply chain actors and 3) The development of a sustainable business model that allows to generate added value and to improve the environmental and social sustainability of the supply chain.

the most relevant factors that positively influence value generation in the Spanish organic food industry are: 1. Product quality, 2. Product traceability, 3. Environmental sustainability, 4. Social responsibility, 5. Product differentiation, 6. Product safety and 7. Consumer satisfaction.
(1) The most relevant sources of value for the Spanish organic olive industry are the organic production, the organic processing, and the organic certification.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the identification of the key value creation processes that can be implemented by the organic olive industry, as well as their potential sources and factors that influence positively or negatively the value creation.
the development of new business models that will allow the organic olive oil supply chain to create value for its stakeholders.
the identification of key value creation factors in the Spanish organic oil supply chain.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

, in the Spanish organic extra virgin olive oil industry, the most important factors to be considered to generate value are: (a) the quality of the olive oil, which should be the highest quality product possible; (b) the use of new technologies, especially those related to the olive oil production process; (c) the use of organic production systems and (d) the use of sustainable production processes.

the most important value drivers in the organic olive supply chain are related with the quality, the traceability and the transparency of the products, the social responsibility of the companies and the sustainability of the supply chain.

value generation along the organic olive oil supply chain is mainly related to the development of innovative products, the adoption of sustainable production and processing practices and the implementation of appropriate quality and marketing strategies.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the value creation process in the organic olive supply chain is mainly driven by a set of factors related to product differentiation and quality, as well as to the adoption of sustainable and responsible business practices.

the business model survey is a powerful tool to elicit and identify the main value creation factors and sources in a supply chain, which are key to the development of innovative, effective and competitive value propositions.
the business model survey is a valuable tool for identifying value creation factors in supply chains.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a business model should not only focus on the economic value but also on the environmental and social value creation.
the business model of a company is a key factor for its success.
the value creation in the organic olive supply chain is not a linear process but a multidimensional process that requires the integration and coordination among different actors and stakeholders.
